description:
This file defines a class `BlockReferenceNode` used within the Twig templating engine. It represents a node that refers to a block in a Twig template, and includes compilation logic to generate PHP code for yielding a block. The class is part of the `Twig
ode` namespace and implements methods for constructing the node and compiling it into executable code.

classes.name:
Twig
ode lockReferenceNode
classes.description: Represents a block reference node in the Twig template engine, used to compile block calls into PHP code.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a BlockReferenceNode with a block name and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the node into PHP code that yields the specified Twig block.
